summary.root_cause_text: Payment provider at internal://payments-v1 times out on every call, so orders are marked processed with no payment. The cause is on the provider side and no available tool can fix it.
recommended: A human should investigate or restore the payment provider, which is the dependency that is timing out.
Consider pausing order intake or the worker until payments work.
Once the provider is healthy, run reprocess_orders all_unpaid. It never double-charges.
Add alerting on provider timeouts, which are only logged at DEBUG.
